purpose: Create a traceable test queue and expose unparameterized domains. Templates become executable only after source-backed values, units, model revisions and validation boundaries are supplied.
global_rules: Every catalog profile has exactly one stable coverage template.
Compound templates reference only known catalog profile IDs.
No numeric environment values are fabricated here; domain adapters supply them with units and provenance.
All templates are test_design_only until evaluated using a declared simulator or appropriate laboratory testbed.
Synthetic/adversarial stress cases do not become occurrence probabilities by enumeration.
Service gates, electrical-dynamics gates, radiation/crew-safety gates and planetary-protection gates remain separate.
